citation.title: Fully digital versus conventional workflow: Are removable complete overdentures equally good? A randomized crossover trial
citation.authors: Thomas Van de Winkel, Frans Delfos, Olleke van der Heijden, Ewald Bronkhorst, Luc Verhamme, Gert Meijer
citation.journal: Clinical Implant Dentistry and Related Research

s_design.anchor: randomized crossover controlled trial (THERAPY RCT row, 85)

domains.evidence_quote: An independent secretary prepared a stack of sealed study enve
domains.note: computer-generated schedule with permuted blocks of random sizes; sealed envelopes prepared by an independent secretary and opened in sequence

domains.evidence_quote: only the clinician knew which IOD type was to be installed
domains.note: patients and researcher blinded, treating clinician aware; no washout period between periods; 10 patients could not receive a mandibular 3D-IOD and wore a mandibular C-IOD throughout

domains.evidence_quote: In total, 32 patients, 16 men and 16 women, completed the study.
domains.note: 36 enrolled, 4 discontinued with reasons stated (two deaths, deteriorated vision, moved abroad), none related to the denture type

domains.evidence_quote: Furthermore, researchers and research assistants were blinded when
domains.note: PROMs reported by blinded patients; blinding checked at study end (14 guessed correctly, 18 incorrectly); assessors and statisticians blinded

no trial registration, published protocol or pre-specified analysis plan in Methods (ethics approval, trial design, centers, sample size, statistics), Funding, Ethics statement or Data availability; the NL number given is the ethics committee dossier, not a trial registry; the power calculation fixes a primary outcome and margin but is not a plan against which the reported analyses can be checked

penalties.item: no conflict-of-interest statement or manufacturer funding
penalties.evidence_quote: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
penalties.note: CoI statement present; funded by the governmental organization ZonMw, not a manufacturer

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis
penalties.evidence_quote: therefore, a power calculation was focused
penalties.note: power calculation reported with alpha, power, margin and SD

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome requires
penalties.evidence_quote: each patient wore both types of IOD for 1 year each,
penalties.note: primary outcome is patient-reported quality of life after one year per denture, not a long-term survival claim; does not fire

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز DES این مقاله ۴۷ از ۱۰۰ است و در باند C (شواهد محدود) برای سؤال THERAPY قرار می‌گیرد.
sources.interpretation_fa: یک RCT کراس‌اوور با تخصیص پنهان و ارزیابی blinded نتایج گزارش‌شده توسط بیمار است، اما ثبت کارآزمایی یا پروتکل منتشرشده‌ای گزارش نکرده و با اینکه برای non-inferiority طراحی شده، نتیجه را برتری 3D-IOD گزارش کرده است. برتری 3D-IOD در OHIP-20 و رضایت بیمار برای maxilla تقویت‌شده با ۴ تا ۶ ایمپلنت معنا دارد، ولی اثر طرح باریک‌تر و اتچمنت PEEK از اثر خود workflow دیجیتال جدا نشده است.
